note: Motion is not a colour or a length, so it lives beside tokens.json. Durations collapse to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Colour, opacity and fills on hover; menus, popovers and tooltips appearing and leaving (`animate-pop-in`, `animate-pop-out`: a fade and a 2px nudge, no scale). Anything anchored to a click.

tokens.name: motion-glide
tokens.usage: Small moves that should still read as motion: a chevron turning, the bulk bar arriving, a drawer opening. Hover and highlights never animate; they are instant.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Dialogs, tab panels, switches, chevrons, the sidebar section swap.

tokens.name: motion-story
tokens.usage: The site only: a passive reveal, a figure settling, the Aurora fading in.

tokens.name: motion-field
tokens.usage: The brand only: the thread art changing mode, the stat marker gliding.

tokens.name: ease-strong
tokens.usage: The house curve for anything entering: a fast start that settles.

tokens.name: ease-sharp
tokens.usage: Small moves inside the product and menus appearing: a quick start and a firm landing, with no float.

tokens.name: ease-in-strong
tokens.usage: Exits: a closing surface gets out of the way.

tokens.name: ease-emphasis
tokens.usage: One small overshoot: a verdict landing, an icon hop. Never on layout.
